prompt: What is the MIDLINE of $y = \sin(x) + 7$? Give the $y$-value.
hint: The midline is set by the number ADDED at the end.

hints.text: The midline is set by the number ADDED at the end.
In $y = a\sin(x) + k$, the midline is $y = k$.

explanation: Adding $7$ lifts every single point of the wave up by $7$, so the whole wave now wiggles around $y = 7$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Average the peak and the trough
steps: sin(x) + 7 rises to 8 at its peak and falls to 6 at its trough.

alternativeExplanations.title: The heartbeat-monitor picture
steps: On a heart monitor there is a flat resting line, and the trace bounces above and below it.
The + 7 tells you where that resting line sits: 7 units up.
